contract: Quality CI must not silently expand direct network capability in test sources actually referenced by the canonical Quality workflow.
baseline_identity: exact Git blob SHA per reviewed Quality-executed loopback source file
source_discovery: test-source paths are derived from .github/workflows/quality.yml; non-executed test harnesses are outside this CI contract
outside_baseline_blocked: socket import or direct socket calls
fail_closed: Quality workflow unreadable or contains no test references
reviewed baseline Git blob SHA drift
direct network-capable import or call outside reviewed baseline
limitations: Source-level expansion guard only. Existing reviewed Quality security/startup tests intentionally use local loopback networking. This does not prove an OS-level egress sandbox and does not fully exclude indirect networking through imported application modules.
boundary: No product/UI/schema/domain behavior, no sudo, no new workflow permission, no secret, no OIDC, no dependency installation and no browser/device gate promotion.
